authorization: User adopts OFF and authorizes concurrent PBS families, two debug-scaling nodes, twelve chains and automatic one-hour continuations; confirmation 8962843 remains untouched.
seed_mapping: Literal training RNG seeds 0,1,2; seed0 is a fresh seed0 run, not the historical seed42 checkpoint.

recipe.global_fair_ES: All distinct ordered sample pairs within each origin, all 24 hours, original masks and train-derived scales

training.budget_definition: Startup, training, selection and checkpoint wall time across all attempts; queue wait, data preparation and evaluation excluded and separately reported. Lost attempts conservatively charged a full hour and parked.
training.resume: Atomic checkpoints; exact manifest, model/optimizer/scheduler/RNG restoration; preserve epoch order and counters. Source snapshot and full configuration hashes checked before every worker.
training.failure_policy: Park the affected chain/grid on scientific failure or unexpected worker exit; do not retry a failed optimizer state or relax any audit. Other chains continue.

data.case30: Reuse immutable released v4 dataset, Stage A audit, scales and embedding cache by checksum; derive new fleet headline IDs mechanically from its existing event-support table.
data.other_grids: Generate v4-law temporal data, 200-hour pilot followed by all 10080 hours; preserve the 10/2/4/4 source-calendar partition law, noise and unresolved-label masks; never tune based on held-out outcomes.
pretraining_gates: CPU parity against official Graphkit CLI and independent OPFData conversion
checked cold/warm/graph-roundtrip solves and dual-sign/units perturbation
full Stage A audit and retained pilot prefix
data.threshold_justification: Unchanged existing Stage A protocols and solver checks; no new scientific acceptance tolerance.
data.headline_rule: All risk-calibration hourly components with >=5 positive days, >=5 negative days and prevalence <0.95; thermal components must also be rated. No test-based choice, top-N selection or fallback when empty.
data.new_bulk_storage: GENCO/runs/v2/fleet_<identity>; GENCO/runs/fleet is a stable symlink for STATUS.md

evaluation.start: As each individual chain finishes, without waiting for other chains
evaluation.partition: All 72 daily test origins, 24 hours each
evaluation.runner: Grid-aware replication orchestration around existing forecast_partition components, frozen scoring.py, replication completion/hash/merge helpers and unchanged same-input solver audit
evaluation.case30_baselines: Read-only hash-checked copies of released C/P/P0/S predictions and references
evaluation.other_grid_baselines: Unchanged ridge/climatology and frozen-GENCO baseline recipe; identical data and evaluation seed across training seeds

scorer_reproduction.fixture: First released case30 v4 origin, all six modes
scorer_reproduction.justification: Same saved predictions and unchanged scorer must reproduce the historical outputs; no model-training tolerance inferred.

evaluation.same_input_audit: Existing fixed sample IDs 0/32 and leads 0/6/12/18/23; A and D share numerical references
evaluation.resumption: Atomic origin completion records and hashes; complete origins never recomputed; no historical manifest rewrite
evaluation.summary: All six modes: arithmetic mean and sample SD (ddof=1) across the three training seeds; missing coordinates reported N/A
evaluation.mixture: A/D: concatenate 64 trajectories from each seed into an equal-weight 192-draw mixture, then rescore with all cross-seed pairs; fixed C/P/P0/S remain identical baseline distributions
evaluation.cross_grid_limit: Different train-derived scales and headline coordinates make cross-grid ES descriptive, not a shared physical error unit

job.launcher: Two MPI launcher ranks, one per node; six independent child processes per node, each externally masked to one flat tile and using xpu:0
job.layout: node0 case14/case30 seeds0/1/2; node1 case57/case118 seeds0/1/2. One seed0 worker prepares each missing grid; its other seeds wait for audited readiness.
job.resubmission: Persistent controller submits next allocation after each fleet boundary, respecting PBS rejection/limits without blocking on unrelated job families
job.status: GENCO/runs/fleet/STATUS.md refreshed at every job boundary and controller update

verification.preservation: Original multigrid working tree and index untouched; all fleet workers execute a hashed snapshot from a separate worktree. Historical released v3/v4 manifests/checkpoints/data are protected by hashes.
